input.goal: Chop half of the onion into smaller pieces and other half into larger bits. Chop the tomatoes into smaller pieces and grind them in a grinder with fresh garlic and green chillies to make a smooth tomato puree. Chop some green chillies into pieces and add them into the puree.

sub_goals.text: Retrieve ingredients from the refrigerator and place them on the tabletop.
Retrieve tools including a chopping board, knife, and scissors.
Retrieve onions and peel the first batch.
Weigh and peel more onions.
Chop the first half of the onions.
Chop the remaining onions.
Separate the chopped onion pieces.
Transfer the chopped onions into a bowl.
Retrieve, weigh, and wash tomatoes.
Slice the first batch of tomatoes and place them in the mixer jar.
Slice the second batch of tomatoes and place them in the mixer jar.
Slice the third batch of tomatoes and place them in the mixer jar.
Slice the fourth batch of tomatoes and place them in the mixer jar.
Slice the final tomatoes and adjust the jar contents.
Wash, weigh, and slice green chillies into the mixer jar.
Retrieve, peel, crush garlic and add it to the mixer jar.
Blend the tomatoes, chillies, and garlic to make a puree and pour it into a bowl.
Add remaining chopped tomatoes to the jar and blend them.
Pour the blended puree into the bowl and rinse the jar.
Retrieve, prepare, and wash additional green chillies.
Chop the green chillies and add them to the puree bowl.

skills.object_recognition: L1: which object is in hand / being handled at the moment of the event
skills.spatial_near: L1: at the moment of the event, which of the listed objects is nearest to a reference object (3D positions from the dataset)
skills.spatial_side: L1: at the moment of the event, which listed object is leftmost / rightmost from the wearer's viewpoint
skills.object_location_at_time: L1: on which surface / fixture / container an object is put down at the event
skills.object_grounding: L1: localise the object of the event in a frame (bounding box)
skills.action_recognition: L2: what action (verb + object) the event is
skills.event_object_role: L2: which object is acted on, with which tool, to which destination in the event
skills.action_temporal_order: L2: the order of two actions shown close together inside one sub-goal
skills.sound_action_binding: L2: which action / object produced the sound heard
skills.object_state_change: L2: where an object was taken from and where it went in one movement
skills.sound_movement_binding: L2: which object movement coincides with the sound
skills.sound_anchored_spatial_near: L2: at the moment of a sound, which listed object is nearest to a reference object
skills.sound_anchored_spatial_side: L2: at the moment of a sound, which listed object is leftmost / rightmost for the wearer

l3_relation_types.object_continuity: the same object / ingredient appears in an event of sub-goal k and an event of the ADJACENT sub-goal k+1; what happened to it between them (chopped broccoli -> in the pan)
l3_relation_types.state_change: how the state of an object differs between the two events (whole -> chopped, empty -> full, raw -> browned)
l3_relation_types.causal_prerequisite: the earlier event is a physical prerequisite of the later one (could not be done without it)
l3_relation_types.hidden_state: an appliance / container state was set in the earlier event and is not visible in the later segment; what is its state at the end of the later segment
l3_relation_types.spatial_end_state: after placements in the two events, which listed object ends nearest / farthest to a reference object (needs 3D records)

The person chops the onion into smaller pieces with the knife.

The person chops the remaining onions into larger bits.
events.relevance: achieves the second part of the onion chopping goal

events.description: The person separates the chopped onion pieces on the board.
The chopped onions are transferred into a bowl.
Tomatoes are placed on the scale.
The tomatoes are washed under running water.
Water is heard running.
The person slices the tomatoes with the knife.
The sliced tomatoes are placed into the mixer jar.
More tomatoes are sliced and placed into the mixer jar.

More tomatoes are sliced and placed into the mixer jar.
The final tomatoes are sliced and placed into the mixer jar.

Green chillies are washed under running water.

The green chillies are sliced and placed into the mixer jar.

events.description: Garlic cloves are peeled and crushed.

events.description: The blender is turned on.
A loud blending sound is heard.
The puree is poured from the mixer jar into a bowl.
Remaining chopped tomatoes are added to the mixer jar.

events.description: The blender is turned on again.
The blended puree is poured into the bowl.
events.relevance: transfers the rest of the puree

events.description: The mixer jar is rinsed under running water.
Additional green chillies are washed under running water.

events.description: The green chillies are chopped with the knife.

events.description: The chopped green chillies are added to the puree bowl.
